trust_boundaries: DMZ -> Core Orchestration Zone (WebUI to AgentOrchestrator)
Core Orchestration Zone -> External Third-Party SaaS (LLMGateway to OpenAI/Anthropic)
Core Orchestration Zone -> Isolated Sandbox Zone (ToolRegistry to CodeExecution)
Core Orchestration Zone -> Knowledge/Data Layer (AgentOrchestrator to VectorDB/UserDB)
architecture_summary.operational_context: Hybrid cloud multi-tenant agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline leveraging external LLM APIs and dynamic tool invocation.

threat_actors.name: External Unauthenticated Attacker
threat_actors.motivation: Financial gain, service disruption, and unauthorized data exfiltration
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Public-facing Web UI web application endpoints and input forms
non_capabilities: No internal network access to backend VPC
No direct access to database credentials or API keys
No ability to bypass cloud provider edge protections without exploit

threat_actors.name: Adversarial Prompt Injection Specialist
threat_actors.motivation: Agent manipulation, goal hijacking, and data exfiltration via indirect prompt injection
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Crafting malicious content indexed by Web Search or stored in Vector Database Documents
non_capabilities: No direct command-line access to internal server infrastructure
No ability to modify system prompt templates directly at rest

threat_actors.name: Malicious Insider / Compromised Developer
threat_actors.motivation: Intellectual property theft, sabotage, and persistence
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Valid internal user credentials, code repository access, or internal management consoles
non_capabilities: No administrative access to external third-party LLM provider infrastructure
No access to customer environment secrets stored in hardware security modules

attack_paths.entry_point: Web UI input or indirect content via WebSearch tool
attack_paths.impact: Agent goal hijacking leading to unauthorized execution of administrative tool calls and sensitive context extraction
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: RAG models processing external untrusted content are highly vulnerable to indirect prompt injection.

attack_paths.technique_name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
attack_paths.entry_point: Agent Orchestrator invoking Code Execution Sandbox tool with untrusted code
attack_paths.impact: Remote code execution within code sandbox container, potentially escaping into host environment
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Dynamic execution of generated code presents significant risk if sandbox isolation is misconfigured.

attack_paths.entry_point: Ingestion of malicious document payloads into DocumentStore and EmbeddingService
attack_paths.impact: Poisoning of vector search results to hijack agent decision pathways and cause wrong data retrieval
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Untrusted external document ingest pipelines can accept specially crafted text to skew vector embeddings.

attack_paths.entry_point: HTTP/HTTPS requests to public Web UI endpoint
attack_paths.impact: Unauthorized access to session tokens, web application compromise, and lateral movement to AgentOrchestrator
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Web UI is exposed to the public internet and susceptible to standard web vulnerabilities.

attack_paths.entry_point: Misconfigured environment variables or configuration files accessible to LLMGateway
attack_paths.impact: Exfiltration of third-party API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic), enabling unmetered quota consumption and data theft
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Requires configuration exposure or file read vulnerability in LLM Gateway.

attack_paths.entry_point: Agent prompt context containing proprietary document data sent to external cloud APIs
attack_paths.impact: Confidential internal enterprise knowledge leaked to third-party model providers or logged in third-party services
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: RAG architecture automatically includes retrieved document contexts into external LLM API payloads.

attack_paths.entry_point: AgentOrchestrator executing database queries using overly privileged database credentials
attack_paths.impact: Unauthorized modification or exfiltration of UserDB records and persistent account compromise
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: If the agent database tool uses excessive privileges, prompt injection can lead to unauthorized SQL execution.

attack_paths.entry_point: Complex, recursive, or extremely long prompt inputs submitted to Local LLM inference server
attack_paths.impact: Resource exhaustion (GPU VRAM / CPU), leading to failure of local inference capabilities and application denial of service
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Local LLMs have finite hardware compute limits and are vulnerable to expensive token generation requests.

mitigations.control_name: Dual-LLM Prompt Sanitization and Output Guardrails
Container Sandboxing and Ephemeral Runtime Execution
Vector Store Ingestion Validation and Data Integrity Integrity Checks
Web Application Firewall (WAF) and Strict Input Validation
Centralized Secrets Manager Integration and IAM Identity Mapping
Data Masking and Private Data Anonymization Filter Prior to External Dispatch
Least Privilege Database Roles and Read-Only Tool Enforcement
Rate Limiting, Max Token Caps, and Concurrent Request Throttling

findings.severity_rationale: Indirect prompt injection via external tools could allow an attacker to bypass access controls and execute arbitrary agent actions.
Untrusted agent-generated code executed in the CodeExecution sandbox could break isolation if container boundaries are insufficient.
Malicious vector payload insertion can degrade RAG accuracy and induce improper LLM output context.
Public Web UI exposed to standard web app vulnerabilities requiring perimeter defenses.
Potential hardcoded credentials in deployment scripts or gateway configurations.
Transmitting sensitive retrieved documents to third-party APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic) risks policy compliance violations.
Database tool executed by agent could query unauthorized data without fine-grained scoping.
Unbounded prompt generation against Local LLM can cause temporary local service unresponsiveness.

agentic.blast_radius: Execution of unauthorized external API queries, sandbox resource exhaustion, read access to vector and relational database stores.
human_oversight_points: Human approval required for DatabaseTool write/update operations
Human approval required for external high-privilege APIIntegrations execution
